native_compute.opposite_views: sequential compute permutation tests, not simultaneous image-qualified views

image_gate.native_command: AESTRA_VOLUME_OUTPUT_REPORTS=<absolute report directory>; AESTRA_SMOKE_ORDER=depth; cargo +1.98.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc test --locked -p aestra-viewer overlapping_particle_smoke_is_repeatable_without_position_readback -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

implementation.storage: 36 * next_power_of_two(max(capacity,256)) + 80 * stage_count + 80 bytes per view/draw pair
implementation.buffer_reuse: while padded capacity unchanged; bind groups refreshed each frame
implementation.cleanup: mode-off and owner removal retire CPU-owned buffers; not exact driver free/VRAM history
implementation.scope: native Camera3d alpha Sprite/Flipbook; does not interleave draws or sort meshes/ribbons/trails/2D/additive

Fast baseline reproduces the failed repeatability under unchanged thresholds; it remains rejected.
Some sandboxed viewer/example tests failed fixture discovery with Access denied; escalated reruns pass.
Default GNU toolchain lacked dlltool.exe; explicit installed MSVC used without changing project defaults.
Public capture exits successfully; shutdown logs include closed screenshot-readback channel warnings.
Raw image-report limitations string remains conservative: general alpha-sort/finale certification is not claimed.
limits: No simultaneous multi-view/arbitrary layer image qualification
Capacity-scaled scratch and merge work even for sparse live pools
No reusable smoke art/persistence acceptance or show migration

report.limitations: bounded two-burst particle-smoke fixture; default layers; unshadowed isotropic point-light scattering; no full-show/smoke art/persistence/alpha-sort/finale certification
